name: Yawai Emi
source:
She is a caring and meddlesome grandmother.

Although she has a family-oriented and gentle side, when she judges a man to be a male, she turns on the switch and becomes lascivious.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_218.html#character]official site[/url]]
